envelope.description: Verify checkpoint recovery, yield and owner isolation

body.title: Verify checkpoint recovery, yield and owner isolation
body.summary: Integrate the compact facade with existing durable recovery, ownership, source freshness and cancellation. Add bounded focus/yield behavior and deterministic compatibility/rollback regressions while reusing the existing journal and completion assessor.
acceptanceChecks: Accepted blocks survive lost replies, daemon restart and cancellation and are not replayed on resume; stale generations and late replies cannot mutate accepted state.

At 60 seconds remaining, new focus is withheld but current assessment and yield can complete until the unchanged hard cap. No timer invents findings, coverage or success; actual elapsed consumption survives pause.
Same-subject ownership contention and independent-subject dispatch follow existing configured admission without cross-run evidence leakage; model/provider calls remain serial.

Stale subject/contracts or changed boundary refuse accurately. Hard-disable stops new turns and cancels/drains active ownership; default rollback selects legacy for new runs while accepted history remains readable.
Incomplete/native-failed sessions cannot publish successful CR; only the unchanged complete-coverage assessor and independent-party publisher may do so. Historical failed acceptance remains failed.

tests.name: compact recovery: lost ACK, restart, cancellation, fencing and no accepted-block replay
compact yield: 60-second focus threshold, current assessment accepted until hard cap
compact isolation: source freshness, concurrent ownership and cross-run evidence refusal
compact rollback: hard-disable cancellation/drain and retained readable history
compact completion: unchanged complete-coverage and independent-party gates
